pages.text: The Termite asks a single fare: nothing. Arrive with an empty inventory and no armor, or it refuses the trip outright.$(p)Beyond waits a world of crystal trees and glass meadows — home to the only veins of $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/tigers_eye)Tiger's Eye$() and pink tourmaline in existence.

pages.title: Working From Nothing
pages.text: Everything you need can be made on-site: crystal wood tools, a crystal workbench, a crystal furnace. Mine, craft, stockpile — then ride a termite home and haul the fortune out in stages.$(p)A maze winds beneath the surface, seeded with crystal chests. The things guarding them hide better than the chests do.
